attempt_note: Every --check run on a distinct spec is recorded in attempts-log.jsonl (45+ records, wrapper scripts/viz-evidence.sh record). Per-view attempt lists count only the structural candidates considered for that view; orientation/label/lane experiments that never shipped are listed in abandoned_shapes with their record labels.

attempts.note: Family recipe probe: OOB plant + in-band world, trunk, tb, labels left in rank gaps. Result (record): extent=63x73 cells | crossings: 2 bridges, 1 touching bends | warning: two edges share 3 cell(s), including ports; increase routing space | labels: 6/6 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous owners | trunks: oobbus from oob to bmc_c, 2 branches, 1 junctions — 73 rows overflow the 47-row target; rejected.

Same structure with label_slot on the five in-band hops so labels take horizontal gutters instead of rank height. Result: extent=63x42 cells | crossings: 2 bridges, 1 touching bends | warning: two edges share 3 cell(s), including ports; increase routing space | labels: 6/6 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous owners | trunks: oobbus from oob to bmc_c, 2 branches, 1 junctions — fits; kept as the structural base.

Final: trunk label shortened from the 13-char 'OOB LAN'/'Redfish/HTTPS' to 'Redfish' (a 13-char trunk label cost 6 rank rows: 63x48 with 'Redfish/HTTPS', record final-v1) and the source's count carried as node label 'Compute BMC x18'. Result: extent=67x42 cells | crossings: 2 bridges, 1 touching bends | warning: two edges share 3 cell(s), including ports; increase routing space | labels: 6/6 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous owners | trunks: oobbus from oob to bmc_c, 2 branches, 1 junctions

Bus and controller fan in the same view (trunk + four API edges). Result: extent=57x34 cells | crossings: 2 bridges, 1 touching bends | warning: two edges share 2 cell(s), including ports; increase routing space | labels: 5/5 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 2 ambiguous owners | warning: 2 label(s) have an ambiguous owner: another route is as close to the text as its own edge | trunks: oobbus from oob to bmc_c, 2 branches, 1 junctions — the fan's labels go ambiguous next to the bus corridor; rejected.

Plain four-lane fan under nv-rms with label_slot on every edge (no trunk: API calls are not a bus). Result: extent=69x14 cells | crossings: 0 bridges, 0 touching bends | labels: 4/4 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 1 ambiguous owners | warning: 1 label(s) have an ambiguous owner: another route is as close to the text as its own edge | trunks: — kept as the structural base.

Final: per-target Redfish labels ('Redfish/HTTPS', 'Redfish power', 'Redfish pshelf') so the three Redfish routes own distinct strings, plus 'Compute BMC x18'. Result: extent=73x14 cells | crossings: 0 bridges, 0 touching bends | labels: 4/4 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 1 ambiguous owners | warning: 1 label(s) have an ambiguous owner: another route is as close to the text as its own edge | trunks: — one ambiguous owner remains (documented defect).

tray view in tb with label_slot. Result: extent=43x21 cells | crossings: 0 bridges, 0 touching bends | labels: 4/4 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 1 ambiguous owners | warning: 1 label(s) have an ambiguous owner: another route is as close to the text as its own edge | trunks: — one ambiguous label in the two-lane NVOS/NMX-C fan; rejected.

Same relations in lr (labels in the vertical rank gap) plus the unconfirmed historical OOB edge drawn dashed. Result: extent=65x10 cells | crossings: 0 bridges, 0 touching bends | labels: 4/4 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous owners | trunks: — final.
